items.fullText: 반도체 배터리 日 파나소닉에너지, 데이터센터 ESS 매출 3배 키운다…전기차 라인 전환 발행일 : 2026-11-26 13:50 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 타다노부 가즈오 파나소닉 에너지 최고경영자(CEO) 원통형 배터리를 주력으로 하는 일본 파나소닉에너지가 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터용 배터리 생산능력을 확대한다. 내후년 데이터센터용 배터리 사업 매출 목표치에 해당하는 프로젝트 대부분을 확보, 생산설비 전환과 북미 공급망 구축에 속도를 낸다. 26일 파나소닉 그룹 배터리 사업 자회사 파나소닉에너지에 따르면 2028년 데이터센터용 에너지저장시스템(ESS) 사업 매출을 2025년도의 약 3배인 1조엔(8조4000억원)으로 늘린다는 계획이다. 이 목표에 담긴 프로젝트 대부분에서 이미 제품 개발 합의나 수주를 따냈다고도 밝혔다. 이같은 수요에 대응하기 위해서 생산능력 확충에도 나선다. 기존 전기차 배터리 라인을 데이터센터용으로 돌리고, 북미에서는 생산부터 부품 조달까지 현지에서 마무리하는 공급망을 구축한다. 일본에서는 오사카 스미노에·가이즈카 공장의 차량용 배터리 라인을 데이터센터용으로 돌리고 있다. 스미노에에서는 올해 4월 출하가 시작됐다. 미국 캔자스 공장에는 데이터센터용 배터리 셀 라인을 들여 2028년도 중 양산에 들어간다. 멕시코에서는 배터리 모듈 제2공장이 지난 7월 가동에 들어갔고, 제3공장은 2027년도 양산이 목표다. 기존 공정을 활용해 짧은 기간에 생산능력을 키운다는 전략이다. 차량용과 데이터센터용 원통형 배터리는 소재와 내부 설계가 다르지만 전극 권취, 조립, 검사 등 공정은 상당 부분 겹친다. 전력부품 내재화에도 나선다. 서버가 쓰는 전압으로 전력을 바꿔 안정적으로 공급하는 직류전압 변환장치(DC-DC 컨버터) 일부를 직접 만든다. 회로기판 등 다른 전력부품은 북미 현지 조달을 늘려, 같은 기간 북미 전력부품 현지 조달률을 50% 이상으로 끌어올린다는 방침이다. 주력 시장인 북미 안에서 생산부터 부품 조달까지 마무리되는 공급망을 갖춰 고객 수요 변화에 유연하게 대응한다. 회사는 2026~2028년도 3년간 이 사업에 3500억엔을 투입한다. 차세대 제품군도 넓히고 있다. 주력인 배터리백업유닛(BBU)에 더해 AI 서버의 순간적인 전력 부하 변동을 흡수하는 슈퍼커패시터 기반 커패시터백업유닛(CBU), 데이터센터 전력 효율을 높이는 고전압직류(HVDC) 대응 BBU를 준비 중이다. CBU 1세대는 2026년도 중 양산한다. 타다노부 가즈오 파나소닉 에너지 최고경영자(CEO)는 “AI는 앞으로 물이나 전기처럼 사회 인프라로 자리 잡을 것”이라며 “데이터센터 같은 대규모 인프라뿐 아니라 휴머노이드를 비롯한 로봇이 활약하는 엣지 영역에서도 '멈추지 않는' 전원에 대한 수요가 커질 것”이라고 말했다. 박유민 기자 newmin@etnews.com

AI 기사요약 미국 증시 반등과 스페이스X 우주 데이터센터 승인 호재로 국내 증시가 상승세를 기록한 가운데 반도체와 이차전지·태양광 관련주는 강세를 보였으나, 자동차주는 실적 및 관세 불확실성 우려로 약세를 나타냈습니다. 코스피가 상승 출발한 26일 오전 서울 중구 하나은행 딜링룸 현황판에 코스피 지수가 표시되고 있다./뉴스1 코스피지수는 26일 오전 11시35분 현재 전 거래일보다 1.24% 오른 4755.91을 기록 중이다. 장중 한때 2%가 넘는 상승률을 보이면서 4800선 진입을 시도했지만 이후 차익실현 매물이 나오면서 상승폭을 일부 반납했다. 외국인이 2058억원, 기관이 4568억원 순매수하는 가운데 개인은 8403억원 순매도 중이다. 코스닥지수는 전날보다 2.15% 오른 664.60을 나타내고 있다. 코스닥지수 역시 장중 3% 넘게 오르기도 했다. 기관이 1740억원을 순매수하고 있지만 개인과 외국인은 각각 1353억원, 397억원을 순매도하고 있다. 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. AI 포인트 뷰 이전 분석 종목 다음 분석 종목 본 서비스의 AI가 제공하는 종목 정보는 정보 제공 목적의 참고 자료일 뿐, 투자 권유·자문·추천에 해당하지 않습니다. 투자에 따른 손실 책임은 사용자에게 있습니다. 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 심우일 기자 심우일 기자는 한국경제신문에서 증권 정책을 취재하고 있습니다. 2018년 기자 생활을 시작해 금융당국, 기획재정부, 산업통상자원부, 증권업계 등을 취재했습니다. 올해 5월부터 한국경제신문 증권부에서 금융위원회와 금융감독원을 출입하고 있습니다. 관련 뉴스

items.t: Trump says pardon is always an option for Huang, and that invoking the Fifth isn’t necessary
items.d: The president’s assertion that Huang does not pose a national security threat has sparked bipartisan backlash on Capitol Hill, where the Nvidia CEO is set to testify next week.
items.fullText: Donald Trump Trump says pardon is always an option for Jensen Huang, and that invoking the Fifth isn’t necessary The president’s assertion that Huang does not pose a national security threat has drawn skepticism on Capitol Hill, where the Nvidia CEO is set to testify next week. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 President Donald Trump presents the National Medal of Science to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in Washington on Oct. 8. Kent Nishimura / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 24, 2026, 9:19 PM EST By Kyla Guilfoil President Donald Trump said that while pardoning Jensen Huang for any potential criminal activity remains an option, he doesn’t think that will be needed for the newly reinstated Nvidia CEO . “It’s always an option, I guess, but I don’t think it’ll be necessary,” Trump told the New York Post in an interview published Tuesday night. Asked about Huang’s scheduled appearances next week on Capitol Hill, Trump said, “I don’t think he needs to take the Fifth. I think it’s an interesting story for people.” “I think I want him to just tell the truth, and I mean, his lawyers are going to have to advise him, but I’ve always found him to be 100% aboveboard, and you know a very smart person,” the president said. A representative for Huang declined to comment on Trump’s comments. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for further comment. Speaking at a news conference Tuesday, Attorney General Todd Blanche indicated he would have told Trump if Huang had been involved in any criminal activity. “To the extent that, that the department, that the Department of Justice had information that he was committing crimes or something like this, that is, that is, that’s just not, that’s something that I would have certainly told the president had it been true,” Blanche said. items.t: Lab says humanoid robot uses living human neurons to help think
items.d: A San Francisco lab is showing off Iris, a humanoid robot with a mood informed by real, living human cells. The lab says the robot communicates wirelessly with lab-grown neurons that originated with human stem cells, which work with complicated AI to help her decide how to feel. It’s an early step for an experiment into how human intelligence can meet artificial intelligence. NBC News’ Steve Patte

items.fullText: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs NVIDIA and Microsoft expand tools for enterprises to customize AI models and deploy applications across cloud and local infrastructure. November 19, 2026 by Dave Salvator 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA and Microsoft are extending their full-stack collaboration to help organizations build, customize and deploy intelligent applications — from next-generation infrastructure on Azure to industrial systems and Windows PCs. At Microsoft Ignite , the companies are expanding access to Azure virtual machines powered by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, as well as adding customer availability to NVIDIA open models and customization capabilities through Microsoft Foundry, and new options for running AI at the edge, where businesses generate and use their data. Microsoft is also using NVIDIA technologies to accelerate its own models and services, including NVIDIA Dynamo inference software for post-training and NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs for Bing search models. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Running in Azure NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems are running in Azure data centers , providing infrastructure designed for demanding reasoning, agentic applications, and large-scale model training and inference. Microsoft and NVIDIA are also collaborating to extend confidential computing to bare-metal and rack-scale AI infrastructure. The work will help protect sensitive models and data while they are being processed, supporting organizations that need to work with proprietary or regulated information. NVIDIA Confidential Computing and attestation help customers verify the computing environment before releasing sensitive models, data or keys. As AI workloads span more interconnected accelerators, the companies are working to extend those protections across the AI factory infrastructure. items.fullText: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents At SC26, NVIDIA’s VP of Hyperscale and HPC laid out how researchers can combine simulation, AI and agents to accelerate scientific discovery. November 17, 2026 by Brian Caulfield 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA’s Ian Buck kicked off the company’s week at SC26 in Chicago on Monday with new tools for AI agents, software that can plan experiments, run code and check results on researchers’ own systems. In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science , the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance computing . He also detailed a new collaboration in quantum computing with IBM and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory . “The frontier of computing and the new scientific stack is going to be simulation, as always, but combined with AI and the future of quantum,” said Buck, vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing at NVIDIA. Buck opened the talk by looking back to his first public talk on CUDA, at an SC06 tutorial in Tampa, Florida, 20 years ago. NVIDIA now offers more than 1,000 CUDA-X libraries , he said. Open Models for Science Agents “[Agents] have been just a game changer in how we interface with our supercomputers, with our devices, our instruments and how we can do the research,” Buck said. Simulation remains the foundation of scientific computing, “which will always be on the top,” Buck said, with AI, quantum and now agents working alongside it. Nemotron for Science combines the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL open model with a new open chemistry dataset and post-training recipes for life sciences and chemistry, Buck explained. Researchers can run it locally on a DGX Spark, a workstation or their own supercomputer. items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Slurm to Bring Quantum Computing Into Supercomputing Quantum hardware developers, software providers and supercomputing centers are adopting the community-built Slurm workloads manager and the NVIDIA quantum platform to integrate quantum processors, design future systems and develop scientific applications. November 16, 2026 by Sam Stanwyck 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Quantum processor deployments at supercomputing centers have grown nearly sevenfold over the past five years, with nearly 30 supercomputing centers around the world now in the process of deploying over 50 quantum processors. Many of these centers use Slurm to run scientific supercomputing workloads, so expanding its support for quantum processors builds on familiar workflows and tools, enabling computational chemists, nuclear physicists and materials scientists to bring quantum computing into their research domains without friction. In a new release, Slurm builds on previous work with IBM, Pasqal and the wider quantum computing community to allow QPU builders to create a single interface to their hardware for every supercomputing center, through a simple file. This makes it easier than ever for HPC centers and QPU builders to integrate and serve their hardware. The expansion is already being adopted by Alice & Bob , IBM , IQM , Pasqal , Quantinuum and MQSC and supports the widely used QRMI and QDMI interfaces. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 Beating the Bottleneck Until now, integrating a QPU into a supercomputing center meant a new software challenge for every new QPU or supercomputing center. By building on existing quantum-HPC interfaces such as QRMI and QDMI, the Slurm expansion allows QPU builders to reuse their integrations across all their deployments. items.fullText: NVIDIA Announces Rubin HPC — A New GPU to Accelerate Agents for Science, Engineering and Analytics A record leap in CUDA cores with accelerated data movement shorten time to results for science and engineering workloads. November 16, 2026 by Dan Ernst 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Announced today at SC26, NVIDIA Rubin HPC is a new GPU in the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform designed to accelerate simulation and data processing for science, engineering and analytics workflows. As agents help scientists and engineers explore more candidate materials, molecules and designs, they rely on simulations to test those ideas and guide their next steps. Rubin HPC will accelerate those simulations, shortening the path from exploration to scientific discovery and industrial design. The Rubin HPC GPU features a record number of CUDA cores — more than 50,000 on a single GPU — as well as a sparse data acceleration capability that keeps those cores fed with data, and accelerates GPU-to-GPU connectivity with seventh-generation NVIDIA NVLink interconnect technology. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 Scientists and engineers rely on simulation to understand complex systems before committing to experiments or physical prototypes. Working with agents, these teams can explore more candidate materials, molecules and designs. This increases demand for the GPU-accelerated simulations needed to evaluate those ideas and guide next steps. “For agents tackling science and engineering, faster simulation means faster discovery,” said Ian Buck , vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing at NVIDIA. “Rubin HPC accelerates the simulations agents use to test ideas and guide their next steps, helping scientists and engineers explore more possibilities and bring breakthroughs closer.” Turning Faster Computation Into Faster Discovery Across climate models, engineering simulations, genomic analysis and financial risk, scientific computing w

items.fullText: AI Day Seoul Brings Together Korea’s Industry Leaders, Startups and Developer Communities November 15, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Over two days at COEX, more than 2,000 attendees converged for AI Day Seoul, bringing together Korea’s industry leaders, startups and developer communities advancing physical AI and AI agents. At the plenary sessions, Deepu Talla, vice president of robotics and edge AI at NVIDIA, said Korea is “punching above its weight,” with Doosan Robotics, Hyundai Motor Group, LG Electronics and SK Group — as well as startups like Real World and Luda Robotics — using NVIDIA platforms to bring general-purpose robotics into the real world. Jonathan Cohen, vice president of applied research at NVIDIA, showed how enterprises can build agents they own and control. Breakout sessions featured speakers from Coupang Intelligent Cloud, Doosan Robotics, LG AI Research, LG Electronics, NAVER Cloud, SK Telecom and Upstage. “It was a genuinely enjoyable time to have candid conversations,” said Hyunho Yang, research engineer for omnimodal foundation models at SK Telecom. “Seeing the passion of fellow AI developers was a real source of inspiration for me.” Community leaders share how they build with open models and tools at AI Day Seoul. The Agentic AI 10x Bootcamp Community Day brought together Pseudo Lab, Python Korea, PyTorchKR, HAERAE, Hugging Face KREW, Graph User Group, Womxn Who Code Korea, Dnol (Datayanolja) and other developer communities. Five finalists from the Hangul Day hackathon, co-hosted with Fastcampus, built agents trained on the Korean language and culture with the OpenShell runtime. The winning team, FlyGate, received an NVIDIA DGX Spark system. More than 500 developers also took part in full-day NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute workshops and NVIDIA Certification exams in Korean. items.fullText: AI Is Helping Care Teams Get Patients the Right Care, Sooner Health systems and startups are using the latest AI technologies to support clinicians, streamline workflows and improve patient care. November 13, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! From pediatric research to smart hospitals, AI is helping care teams spend less time on routine tasks and more time with patients. Health systems and startups are putting it to work across healthcare, from matching patients to clinical trials to supporting radiologists, hospital teams and patients at home. Clinicians stay at the center, reviewing AI outputs and guiding decisions, while NVIDIA technologies provide the compute behind the applications. Read on to learn how healthcare teams are using AI to improve and speed patient care. Tuesday, Nov. 17, 8:00 a.m. PT 🔗 Proximie Helps Surgical Teams Spend Less Time on Logistics and More Time With Patients As AI advances healthcare, surgery is a high-stakes, highly regulated setting for its use — and one with significant opportunity for efficiency gains. Only about 10% of time spent in the operating room is clinical. The rest is devoted to scheduling, turnover and documentation. With the help of NVIDIA technology, Proximie is introducing AI into operating room (OR) logistics so that clinicians can focus on taking care of patients. A New Vantage Point Proximie is using NVIDIA Cosmos 3 , the frontier open world foundation model family for physical AI, to power a platform used in more than 700 ORs today. Trained on a decade of data, it captures real-time audio, video and device signals from a close-up view of the surgery as well as a wide view of the whole room. The comprehensive view offers context held by no single person in the room, whether the surgeon, scrub nurse or coordinator.
